newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai service sector provides more jobs.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai service sector provides more jobs.

text.p: Shanghai's service sector accounts for 48 percent of the city's total employment, an increase of 20 percentage points against the beginning of 1990s, the Business News said on Monday.
The number of people working in the city's industrial sector had fallen to 52 percent from 70 percent in the early 1980s, partly due to the introduction of high technology, the newspaper said.
The service sector now accounted for 44 percent of Shanghai's gross domestic product (GDP), surging from around 20 percent at the beginning of 1980s, it said.
Shanghai, China's richest city and its mercantile hub, aimed to increase the proportion of GDP accounted for by the service sector to 60 percent, the newspaper said.
